name: Work Relations and Assignments
constraints: At most one open EmployeeProfile exists for one personRef and one employerRef; remediation uses evidenced succession, never an unlinked duplicate.
employerRef resolves to an employing legal party, never an org unit, brand, payroll code, site or free text.
personRef is immutable; Person merge or split creates evidenced profile succession and never an in-place rewrite.
EmployeeProfile is a status-neutral administrative label and never proves employment or legal classification.
A profile version is bitemporal; corrections retain valid time and advance record time, while amendments advance valid time.
Withdrawn versions remain resolvable with digest, record interval and withdrawal reason.
Active versions use non-overlapping half-open valid intervals within one record-time slice.
A ProfileEmploymentLink may be absent; profile existence therefore implies no relationship or status.
Each ProfileEmploymentLink names one typed WM-ORG-005 relationship and carries its own valid and record intervals.
One relationship links to exactly one profile at an instant, except during evidenced legal succession.
Evidenced employer succession creates a same-Person successor profile and dated link transfer while preserving the Employment relationship.
successorRef targets a profile with the same personRef and requires successionReason plus successionEvidenceRef.
A closed profile may reactivate only on evidenced rehire; a superseded profile never reactivates.
Employee numbers are unique on employerRef, numberSchemeRef and number over non-overlapping half-open validity intervals; voided bindings are excluded.
Number policy comes from the scheme; issuance fails when no reuse policy exists and records the applied policy version.
A number binding derives employer scope from its profile and can never name or imply a different employer.
Voided number bindings remain resolvable and never imply that the number was held.
Profile closure closes but never deletes open number bindings; historical lookup remains possible.
Administrative category assertions qualify exactly one relationship and never the profile as a whole.
Legal or statutory category assertions require a competent determinationRef; internal assertions are explicitly non-determinative.
Category assertions have governed purpose and jurisdiction schemes plus visible dispute state and append-only overturn history.
Profile amendments never duplicate or silently retarget independent category assertions.
Profile closure is forbidden while required accessVerificationOutcomeRefs are absent or unverified; dormant is permitted.
Profile state never substitutes for Employment, Assignment, JML or access-authority state.
Closed, dormant, withdrawn, voided and superseded records remain historically resolvable.
No model or runtime identifier is assigned until registry allocation; newRuntimeId false means none is allocated in this checkpoint.
newRuntimeIdGloss: No runtime identifier is allocated in this checkpoint; a future standalone model requires registry allocation first.
